The Dick Tracy is a small bakelite camera for 127 film, made c.1947 by Seymour Products Co, using a 1938 design by Jack Galter[http://www.freepatentsonline.com/D114324.pdf US design patent 114,324] from [http://www.freepatentsonline.com/ freepatentsonline.com].
